name: AEM X-Series Wideband (AEMnet)
note: Every lambda field arrives UNSET, which is the point: set a lambda sensor's interface to CAN and point its frame and start bit at the field, so the reading comes with that sensor's calibration, operating window and P-codes instead of as a bare number on the bus. THE ODD ONE OUT: 29-bit identifiers at 500 kbit, where every other wideband here is 11-bit at 1 Mbit — it cannot share a bus with them. 100 Hz. The gauge menu's ID 1..ID 16 are 0x180..0x18F, so a second controller is this template with the id stepped. There is no free-air code; byte 6 bit 7 is LAMBDA DATA VALID and byte 7 bit 6 is SENSOR FAULT, and a reading is only worth having while that valid bit is set. Covers 30-0300, 30-0310, 30-0333/0334 and 30-0350.
